description: This file defines a PHP interface named 'Page' within the namespace 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\Base'. The interface declares two methods: getPureContent() and getContent(), which are intended to be implemented by classes representing different types of pages or content objects.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: An interface defining methods for accessing page content in different formats.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Returns the converted content without any template, as a string.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the full content, potentially of any data type.
